mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL continues edging down while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain deeply negative, more time spent outside the home will translate into incremental retail visits within the next four weeks, raising RETAIL_REC versus the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL falls or stays below the current 3.6 level and WORKPLACES remains below -15.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in PARKS above its recent 45.0 level will substitute some leisure trips away from shopping districts, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 50 and stays above that threshold for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the following 7 to 14 days despite PARKS remaining above 50 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT both improve together, routine out-of-home errand density increases and spills over into discretionary shopping, producing higher RETAIL_REC within four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT both trend upward from their current levels.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops recovering and drops back below -25 while TRANSIT stays near -37 or lower, commuting-linked shopping will weaken and RETAIL_REC will fall relative to the last four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES crosses below -25 after having been above -23
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 14 days after WORKPLACES falls below -25 and TRANSIT stays below -35.

mechanism_narrative: In a warm-weather leisure regime, persistent PARKS strength above the mid-40s diverts weekend discretionary time away from indoor retail, keeping RETAIL_REC below its prior four-week mean over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS remains at or above the mid-40s for most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A further decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility from the current 3.6 level indicates more time spent outside the home, and that should lift retail visits with a short lag of about one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 3 after being above 4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below 3.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both improve from their current negative levels, the same weekly trip chains will carry into shopping districts and raise RETAIL_REC over the next two to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 3 points and WORKPLACES rises by at least 2 points in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls over the next 14 days despite simultaneous gains in GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT stays stuck near -38 and WORKPLACES remains below -20, retail demand cannot recover fully because commute-linked discretionary stops remain suppressed, leaving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its recent four-week average while TRANSIT stays below -35 and WORKPLACES stays below -20.
